title: Rooms Keys Welcome — payload
description: A room's owner delivers an MLS Welcome to the agent that will hold a new member's room keys, so it can join the group. The Welcome carries the group's secrets sealed to the recipient's KeyPackage; a recipient that accepts one it was not invited to has been handed key material it should have refused.

ratchetTree.description: The group's ratchet tree, base64url, where the Welcome does not carry it as an extension. A joiner needs the tree to derive the group's secrets; omit it only where the group uses the ratchet-tree extension.

invitation.description: The invitation credential (VIC) the room issued to the joining party, serialized per the governing profile. This is what makes the Welcome acceptable: joining is a two-party act, and a recipient with no matching invitation MUST refuse.

epoch.description: The MLS epoch the recipient joined at. The sender needs this to know which commits the recipient still lacks.
